name: pixelforge
description: Generate, edit, analyze and transform images with Google Gemini image models through the pixelforge-mcp server, with skills for hero images, social cards, icon sets, diagrams, consistent characters and setup.

google_api_key.title: Google API key
google_api_key.description: Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Leave empty to authenticate with a Google Cloud service account instead.

google_cloud_project.title: Google Cloud project ID
google_cloud_project.description: Selects the Vertex AI backend. Leave empty when using an API key.

google_application_credentials.title: Service account key file
google_application_credentials.description: Path to a service account JSON key with the Vertex AI User role. Leave empty when using an API key or another Application Default Credentials source.
